evals.prompt: I need to add a new business module called 'product' for managing products in the dashu project. It has fields like product_name, product_code, price, status, and category_id. Please generate the complete backend CRUD code following the framework conventions, including Entity, DTO, Convert, Mapper, Service, Controller, and Excel support. Use the code generator patterns.
evals.expected_output: Complete CRUD code for a new 'product' module following dashu framework conventions — Entity (@TableName, @TableId ASSIGN_UUID), DTO (implements BaseDTO, @ApiModel), Convert (extends BaseConverter, @Mapper), Service (extends ServiceImpl, @Transactional), Controller (@RestController, @PreAuthorize, @NoRepeatSubmit, standard 7 endpoints), Excel export/import support, and proper package structure under com.kg.module.product.

assertions.name: Entity uses @TableName with correct naming
assertions.description: Entity class must have @TableName('z_product') and @TableId with IdType.ASSIGN_UUID

assertions.name: Controller has standard 7 CRUD endpoints
assertions.description: Controller must include getById, list, add, update, delete, export/excel, import/excel endpoints

assertions.name: Convert extends BaseConverter with MapStruct config
assertions.description: Convert interface extends BaseConverter<Product, ProductDTO> with @Mapper(config = BaseConverterConfig.class)

evals.prompt: What is the module dependency chain in the dashu framework? Explain the role of each module and how the packages are organized.
evals.expected_output: Explanation of component → core → module dependency chain, with each module's root package (com.kg.component.*, com.kg.core.*, com.kg.module.*) and their responsibilities.

assertions.name: Correct dependency chain direction
assertions.description: Must state component ← core ← module dependency

evals.expected_output: Code review identifying violations: missing @PreAuthorize, missing @NoRepeatSubmit on add, returning Entity directly instead of DTO, returning raw string instead of using ResponseResult auto-wrapping, missing @Api annotation, missing @Transactional on service.

assertions.name: Identifies missing @PreAuthorize
assertions.description: Review must flag missing @PreAuthorize on both endpoints

assertions.name: Identifies returning Entity instead of DTO
assertions.description: Review must flag that Entity should not be returned directly — must use Convert to DTO

assertions.name: Identifies missing @NoRepeatSubmit
assertions.description: Review must flag missing @NoRepeatSubmit on the POST /add endpoint

assertions.name: Identifies missing Convert injection
assertions.description: Review must flag missing ZUserConvert injection and DTO conversion

evals.prompt: What version of MyBatis-Plus and MapStruct does the dashu framework use? Also what is the base converter config and how do I create a new Convert interface?
evals.expected_output: MyBatis-Plus 3.5.6, MapStruct 1.4.1.Final. BaseConverterConfig with componentModel=spring, injectionStrategy=CONSTRUCTOR. New Convert extends BaseConverter<Entity, DTO> with @Component @Mapper(config = BaseConverterConfig.class).

assertions.name: Correct BaseConverterConfig pattern
assertions.description: Must describe BaseConverterConfig and the Convert interface pattern correctly

evals.prompt: How does the dashu framework handle uniform response and exceptions? Show me the ResponseResult class structure and how to throw business exceptions with proper error codes.
evals.expected_output: ResponseResult with code/message/timestamp/data fields, static success()/error() methods. Controllers return DTOs auto-wrapped by ResponseResultBodyAdvice. BaseException with String or BaseErrorCode constructors. GlobalExceptionHandler catches all exceptions and returns standardized ResponseResult.

assertions.name: ResponseResult structure explained
assertions.description: Must describe code, message, timestamp, data fields and static factory methods

assertions.name: Auto-wrapping via ResponseResultBodyAdvice
assertions.description: Must explain that controllers return DTOs directly and ResponseResultBodyAdvice auto-wraps them

assertions.name: BaseException usage
assertions.description: Must show how to throw BaseException with String or BaseErrorCode
